subject: shiny app through AMI public DNS launch.browser=f() ?

messages.author: 2896806ac247e4cf
messages.subject: shiny app through AMI public DNS launch.browser=f() ?
parts:
hi,

this is related to an issue i've raised at the bioc-devel list here:

https://stat.ethz.ch/pipermail/bioc-devel/2014-May/005792.html

i'm running RStudio through port 8787 in an AMI at AWS and I would like to start a shiny app at that AMI opening a new browser window  in my laptop from where i connect to the AMI through its public DNS. let's say i try to do it with the simple example from the runApp() help page:

library(shiny)

runApp(list(
        ui = bootstrapPage(
          numericInput('n', 'Number of obs', 100),
          plotOutput('plot')
        ),
        server = function(input, output) {
          output$plot <- renderPlot({ hist(runif(input$n)) })
        }
      ), host="0.0.0.0", port=6219)

a new window will open trying to access the following URL

http://127.0.0.1:6219

obviously that gives the error "Unable to connect", but if i replace "127.0.0.1" by the public DNS of my AMI (http://ec2-xx-xx-xx-xx.compute-1.amazonaws.com), then it works.

i'm trying to find the way to avoid this manual step, i.e., that the browser window is opened with the URL correctly specified with the public DNS and the app starts directly working without an error.

according to the hint i was given at the bioc-devel list, i probably should be using the 'launch.browser' argument of the runApp() function, with a function that finds out the public DNS from the AMI metadata available at http://ec2-xx-xx-xx-xx.compute-1.amazonaws.com/latest/metadata following the instructions at 

http://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/AESDG-chapter-instancedata.html

however, i cannot find documentation about how to build this function that the argument
'launch.browser' can take and how i can interrogate the metadata URL from R.

any idea on how to solve this will be highly appreciated,

thanks!
robert.
